# ramen-agents

> ramen-agents is an open-source, free AI agent team for a small business: it finds leads, writes the first outreach
> email, researches the market and prices service packages, and a local dashboard shows the agents working. It is for
> founders and small agencies with time and a laptop but no budget, and it costs nothing to run: free model tiers and
> keyless search, no card anywhere. A hard fence in the code stops any agent from creating accounts, spending money or
> collecting personal data. Licence: Apache-2.0.

## What it is

- A family of web agents (The CEO, Lead Gen, Outreach Writer, Package Designer, Research Analyst, Scout), a Validator
  that checks every write against the owner's rules, and a local Next.js dashboard drawn as a small pixel world.
- Each agent is a folder with a `config.toml` and a `persona.md` in plain English; one Python program (`bot`) runs them.

## Who it is for

- Founders and small agencies who do lead research and first emails by hand today and have no software budget.

## What it costs

- Nothing. The default model chain is free tiers only (Z.ai, Gemini, Groq, Speka, Mistral, OpenRouter free models,
  Ollama Cloud, then a local Ollama model); search is keyless (SearXNG, DuckDuckGo via MCP, FreeSerp). Each provider's
  free daily limits are counted so the family slows down instead of running up a bill.

## How to start

- Ten minutes, no key, no network: `git clone -b engine https://github.com/reBuzz-llc/ramen-agents`, `pip install -e .`,
  `bot new "My Explorer" --fake --dir ./demo-fleet`, `bot --config ./demo-fleet/my-explorer/config.toml demo`.
- The real setup, by hand or with an AI coding agent: clone `-b fleet` to `~/bots`, follow `docs/setup-queue.md`, and run
  `python3 scripts/setup-check.py` after each step (it names what is missing and where to get it). The agent never
  creates accounts or keys; it asks the person for each one.
- Requirements: Python 3.11+ for the engine; the always-on setup (launch agents, dashboard service) targets macOS.
